newFileText: Type or paste JSON, a JSON array, or JSONL. Apply it to hand the content to the local document.
draftTooLarge: A new-file draft cannot exceed 8 MiB.
searchHint: Type to search the entire file
emptyTitle: A little clarity for your JSONL.
emptyText: Explore datasets, traces and logs. One line, one record. Everything stays on your Mac or Linux desktop.
scratchNotice: Unsaved document · Save to choose a location on your desktop.
changed: This file changed outside JSONL Studio.
previewLimitNotice: This record exceeds 2 MiB. The first 2 MiB are shown; file validation still streams the complete record.
sourcePreviewLimited: This range contains large records. Original view shows the first 2 MiB of each record.
noRecords: No records yet. Paste data to begin.
browser: Browser preview supports paste and sample data. Open local files in the desktop app.
bounded: Loaded range capped at 1,000 lines / 8 MiB. Next continues.
replaced: The current unsaved session will be replaced. Continue?
appliedUnsaved: Changes applied; save to write them to disk
deleteConfirm: Delete this record? The source file changes only when you save.
editHint: Edit one JSON value. It becomes one JSONL line when applied. Save writes your changes to disk.
recovery: An unsaved document is available to recover.
overwrite: The destination already exists. Replace it?
browserSave: Disk saving is available in the desktop app.
closeUnsaved: Close with unsaved changes? Your applied changes are kept for recovery.
